note: Re-judged 2026-11-02 by an independent auditor who authored none of the bgp-role changes. RFC 9234 Section 4.2: "If the Roles do not correspond, the BGP speaker MUST reject the connection using the Role Mismatch Notification (code 2, subcode 11)." The only change to the file-scoped .ci units it judged (655d07b59b, 3459b6e390) deletes the `policy { reject-asn NO-TRANSIT { indirect [ 3356 ] } }` block, its four comment lines, and `filters [ inactive:NO-TRANSIT ];` from each bound import and export chain, leaving `final accept;`. That filter was deactivated and never ran; it existed only because the config then required a role's bound chain to name a transit-refusing filter, and 655d07b59b made that check a filter the bgp-role plugin inserts itself. Every OPEN capability option, every action=send and every expect/reject line (the exact NOTIFICATION or UPDATE hex) is byte-identical, so each case still isolates the same condition and asserts the same exact outcome. The discrimination records on these .ci carriers (validateOpenRolePair) were re-taken over the changed units in this session. Verdict unchanged: enforced. Earlier judgement follows. Rejudged 2026-10-31 by an auditor who authored none of the change. The only change to test/plugin/peer-open-role-complement.ci and role-mismatch-notification.ci since the last stamp is cabb706c11 moving the policy block from inside bgp {} to the top-level policy root, the same lines re-indented; every action, expect, reject and option line is byte-identical, so the carriers drive the same inputs and assert the same outcomes. Verdict unchanged. RFC 9234 Section 4.2: "If the Roles do not correspond, the BGP speaker MUST reject the connection using the Role Mismatch Notification (code 2, subcode 11)." Producer role/validate.go::validateOpenRolePair checks Table 2; server/validate.go::askOpenValidators converts a rejected ValidateOpenOutput into OpenValidationError and reactor/session_open_validation.go::runOpenValidator sends its codes. role-mismatch-notification.ci supplies Provider/Provider and requires exact FFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFF001503020B, rejecting EoR; peer-open-role-complement.ci changes the remote role to Customer, requires EoR and rejects 03020B. TestValidateOpenRolePair_ValidPairs and InvalidPairs pin accept/refuse and exact codes; TestValidateOpenRolePairRunsForADynamicGroupMember also checks group lookup, refusal and complementary acceptance. Server TestBroadcastValidateOpenRefusesAnUnansweredPerPeerPolicy, TestAskOpenValidatorsLeavesASilentPluginPending and TestBroadcastValidateOpenAcceptsAPeerWithNoPerPeerPolicy retain the owner-selected fail-closed plumbing: those are supplemental robustness evidence, not a claim that the RFC equates plugin silence with an observed role mismatch. Rejudged independently against RFC source and every tagged carrier on 2026-10-22. Functional judgments use the corresponding test/draft/plugin files, not the unpromoted old-syntax live files. Their inactive NO-TRANSIT import/export policies explicitly end in accept; reactor runEgressPolicyChain applies that final only after mandatory in-process OTC, and OPEN validation is independent. This is a source judgment, not a new runtime or discrimination result; parent owns promotion and native freshness before stamping.
